def get_operation_details(self, op_id, user):
    """
    op_id: operation id
    user: authenticated user
    """
    if not user:
        return None
    operation = Operation.query.filter_by(id=op_id).first()
    operation = {
        "id": operation.id,
        "path": operation.path,
        "description": operation.description
    }
    return operation
